digest.component_or_area: LLM code-review impact model (Pass-2 verifier + impact decider)
propositions: Pass-2 must gate unversioned_published_contract_break as TRUE only when a removal lacks version/deprecation signal (major bump, deprecation cycle, or CHANGELOG breaking-change entry); managed removals return FALSE

A removal of a public symbol (reachable via __all__, re-export, CLI command, or MCP tool) without version signal triggers a deterministic serious-tier boost to 0.9 in impact_code, amplified by existing non-silent multiplier to 0.72, never suppressing lower scores

The citric-preregal-ladybird replay (deleted PUBLIC API rebar.llm.review_ticket, capability-degraded + reachable-path-without-coverage + rare trigger + removed-public-symbol attrs) must score ≥0.60 to clear both deletion-impact@0.60 and api-compat@0.51 flips
Detection of removed-public-symbol keys on EXPORT (API visibility) not on cited caller presence; absence of internal caller does not prove external API unused
IMPACT_MODEL_VERSION increments from code-v4 to code-v5; sidecars segment by version to enforce impact-model semantics drift

Prompt/field descriptions on both Pass-2 surfaces (verify_models.py CodeSeverityAttrs + code-review-verify.md bullet) must name the version-signal gating rule and the export-keyed removed-public-symbol sub-question wording
